settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Site, inverter, solar, load, plan, EV, safety and system
settings.solarIntro: Forecast each MPPT string from Open-Meteo tilted irradiance and a temperature model. Up to three strings.
settings.loadIntro: The house-load profile distributes the daily energy across the day. Measured telemetry is blended in once enough history exists.
settings.temperatureHelp: Colder weather raises the forecast above the reference; warmer weather lowers it, using the PV forecast's hourly temperature.
settings.profileHelp: Relative weights per local hour; saved normalized to sum to 1.
settings.planIntro: Control the optimiser horizon, slot budget, reserve policy and battery setpoints. The plan is always a dry-run suggestion in this phase.

info.eltariffURL: Optional Eltariff API endpoint for fetching this facility's grid charges.
info.tariffMode: Choose manual tariff entry or the Eltariff API.
info.transferFeeOre: Manual grid transfer fee added per imported kWh, in öre.
info.energyTaxOre: Manual energy tax added per imported kWh, in öre.
info.variableCostOre: Additional variable import cost per kWh, in öre.
info.fixedMarkupOre: Fixed per-kWh import markup, in öre.
info.exportBenefitOre: Grid benefit credited per exported kWh, in öre.
info.exportExtraOre: Extra grid-owner supplement credited per exported kWh, in öre.
info.showFullPrice: Show import and export prices including grid fees and taxes instead of spot prices.
info.license: Docker Hub personal access token with read access to the image repository. Used by the update check; stored on the server and never returned by the API.
info.host: IP address or hostname of the inverter dongle.
info.scheme: HTTP or HTTPS used to reach the dongle.
info.port: TCP port of the dongle API.
info.serial: Inverter/dongle serial used by the telemetry and schedule endpoints.
info.capacity: Usable battery capacity used for SOC, energy and savings calculations.
info.telemetryInterval: How often inverter telemetry is polled.
info.maxCharge: Hardware limit for battery charging power.
info.maxDischarge: Hardware limit for battery discharging power.
info.minSoc: Lowest SOC the planner may use; also the lower SOC bound.
info.maxSoc: Highest SOC the planner may charge to.
info.reserveSoc: Hard floor for discharge; the planner never goes below it.
info.chargeEfficiency: Charging efficiency used when converting grid energy into stored energy.
info.dischargeEfficiency: Discharging efficiency used when converting stored energy back to the house.
info.sign: Invert the reported sign if this meter or battery reports positive/negative flow reversed.
info.acLimit: Maximum AC output used to cap the PV forecast.
info.confidence: Confidence factor applied to the PV forecast; lower values reduce planned PV.
info.refresh: How often the Open-Meteo forecast is refreshed.
info.calibration: Scale the PV forecast using measured production history.
info.kwp: DC peak power of this PV string.
info.tilt: Panel tilt in degrees from horizontal.
info.azimuth: Panel direction in compass degrees: 0 north, 90 east, 180 south.
info.pr: Performance ratio of the PV system, accounting for wiring and soiling losses.
info.tempCoefficient: PV power change per degree of cell temperature.
info.maxW: Per-string or inverter cap applied to this string's forecast.
info.dailyKwh: Baseline daily household consumption before measured or temperature adjustment.
info.useMeasured: Blend the last 14 days of measured load into the forecast, by weekday and hour.
info.useTemperature: Raise the load forecast in cold weather and lower it in warm weather using the hourly temperature forecast.
info.temperatureReference: Outdoor temperature where no temperature adjustment is applied.
info.temperatureSensitivity: Load change per degree away from the reference temperature.
info.hourlyProfile: Relative household load weight for this local hour; weights are normalized to 1.
info.maxSlots: Maximum number of battery windows the planner may create per day.
info.maxSlotMin: Maximum duration of one planned battery window.
info.horizonDays: How many days ahead the planner optimizes.
info.minDailySaving: A plan below this expected saving is discarded and replaced by self-consumption.
info.chargeW: Target charging power written for charge windows.
info.dischargeW: Target discharging power written for discharge windows.
info.endSoc: End-of-horizon SOC floor, capped by the starting SOC.
info.preserveSoc: Enforce the end SOC target at the end of the planning horizon.
info.allowGrid: Allow battery discharge to export to the grid; applies to the sales-profit strategy.
info.strategy: Choose whether the planner minimizes purchase cost or maximizes sales profit.
info.minPriceDifference: Required future price advantage before the planner charges.
info.maxPurchasePrice: Highest import price eligible for charging. 0 means only zero or negative prices.
info.peakShaving: Cap hourly grid import and remove active charging when the cap is reached.
info.peakLimit: Maximum hourly grid import used by peak shaving.
info.evMode: Default EV charging mode: off, immediate or smart.
info.evProvider: Adapter used to control the charger. Changing it requires a restart.
info.evChargerID: Vendor charger identifier or serial number.
info.evInstallationID: Zaptec installation identifier used for current limits.
info.evZaptecUsername: Zaptec account username stored with the charger configuration.
info.evZaptecPassword: Zaptec account password stored locally and never returned by the API.
info.evCurrent: Minimum and maximum charger current per phase.
info.evPhases: Number of phases used by the EV charger.
info.evVoltage: Nominal voltage used for power calculations.
info.evSolarShare: Share of EV charging that should come from PV surplus, in percent.
info.evBatteryFloor: Battery SOC that EV charging must leave untouched.
info.evAlwaysCharge: Keep charging regardless of price or solar surplus.
info.evSmartCost: Highest import price at which smart charging is allowed.
info.evFeedIn: Feed-in price above which battery discharge is prioritised.
info.evSolarOnly: Charge the EV only from PV surplus; charging stops when there is no surplus.
info.evAllowBatteryCharging: Allow the EV to draw energy from the house battery while charging. When disabled, the battery is held in reserve mode and its charge ceiling is capped at max(current SOC, 50%) until the EV stops charging.
info.writesArm: Arm schedule writes to the inverter. The environment gate must also be enabled.
info.evArm: Arm actual EV charger control. The environment gate opens automatically once the charger is configured and its status polls succeed.
info.watchdog: Clear a stale schedule after this many seconds without a successful update.
info.horizonLimit: Maximum number of days a schedule may cover.
info.autoScheduleWrite: Automatically download a new plan when its schedule differs from the inverter. Manual plans and foreign schedules are never overwritten.

settings.planHelpSubtitle: Automatic suggestions, price strategy, peak shaving and write safety.
settings.planHelp1: Every five minutes Aiptimize combines prices, PV and load forecasts, battery SOC and your limits into a new automatic plan suggestion. The suggestion alone never writes to the inverter.
settings.planHelp2: The plan uses 30-minute slots. A slot starts on :00 or :30, lasts 30–240 minutes, cannot overlap or cross midnight, and must stay within the daily slot budget.
settings.planHelp3: Minimize purchase cost creates charge-only slots: cheap energy is stored and later used by the house. Minimum price difference and maximum purchase price decide whether charging is worthwhile.
settings.planHelp4: Maximize sales profit may charge and discharge, including export, when the price spread is attractive.
settings.planHelp5: Peak shaving tracks the current hour's highest grid import. When the limit is reached, an active charge slot is removed so the house can fall back to self-consumption.
settings.planHelp6: Preserve end SOC applies a floor at the end of the planning horizon: min(end SOC target, starting SOC). Reserve SOC remains the hard discharge floor at all times.
settings.planHelp7: An applied manual plan locks its day. Automatic recalculation continues but does not overwrite it. Saving a draft or downloading a plan changes what is applied.
settings.planHelp8: Saving to the inverter requires armed writes. The schedule is read back for comparison, and per-slot power is adjusted at slot start when needed.

settings.safetyIntro: Write gates are the in-app half of two independent switches. The inverter environment gate must also be enabled before anything can be sent to hardware. The EV environment gate is automatic: it opens when a charger is configured and its status polls succeed.
